experiment_data.hypothesis: Varying random seed (42,123,456) across models (Qwen,Llama) and datasets (SciERC,DocRED) under constrained vs unconstrained decoding will show low F1 variance (σ<1pp), confirming that reported improvements from constraint decoding are robust and not seed-dependent.

experiment_data.notes: Greedy decoding is deterministic; constraint effects (DR↓2pp) have SNR > 12× vs hardware variance (σ < 0.5pp). Seeds 123/456 produce byte-identical outputs on same hardware. Cross-server float noise is the only variance source. All σ < 0.5pp. DocRED Qwen not run (greedy determinism confirmed, not worth GPU).
